meta.name: gstack-guard
meta.description: GStack guard method for strengthening scope boundaries, forbidden actions, stop conditions, and validation gates for an agent or workstream.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为智能体设置边界约束与验证关卡
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在构建智能体时需要定义其行为边界和验证规则。
copy.tagline_en: Set boundary constraints and validation gates for agents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building agents and need to define their behavior boundaries and validation rules.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会为当前任务生成安全护栏：明确禁止操作、停止条件、验证关卡，并强化角色边界，防止越权行为。
howto.when: 当角色提示需要更强边界、可能触碰禁止文件或操作、架构需要护栏，或用户明确说“$gstack-guard”时触发。

say.text: 请为这个任务加上 gstack-guard 护栏。
say.note: Claude 会生成禁止操作和验证关卡。

say.text: 用 gstack-guard 强化当前角色的边界。
say.note: Claude 会修订提示词，加入边界和停止条件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates guardrails: forbidden actions, stop conditions, validation gates, and strengthens role boundaries to prevent scope creep.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a role prompt needs stronger boundaries, risk of touching forbidden files/actions, architecture requires guardrails, or user explicitly says "$gstack-guard".

say_en.text: Add gstack-guard guardrails for this task.
say_en.note: Claude will produce forbidden actions and validation gates.

say_en.text: Use gstack-guard to strengthen the current role's boundaries.
say_en.note: Claude will revise the prompt with boundaries and stop conditions.
